verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas doesn't ship a built-in in-product AI chat assistant, but it does provide official infrastructure for AI delegation: the Editor MCP Server lets external AI assistants modify project data and verify results via the viewport/running app, and new projects ship 'PlayCanvas Skills' giving compatible AI coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows. This satisfies the agentic delegation spirit but relies on external agents connecting via MCP/skills rather than an assistant embedded inside the product UI itself. Missing for 10: a first-party in-editor chat/assistant UI, independent hands-on validation of the MCP workflow, and confirmation this isn't just a thin protocol bridge.
